newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX ends at all-time record high close.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX ends at all-time record high close.

text.p: 1620 GMT - German DAX index of 30 top shares powers ahead in post-bourse electronic dealings to end at new record close, after German Bund future makes new all-time high, despite U.S. markets being closed for Thanksgiving holiday.
* 30-share IBIS DAX ends at 2,829.68 points, up 1.28 percent, or 35.82 points, having earlier hit 2,832.30 points. Bourse closed earlier at record of 2,817.49 points.
* December DAX future makes new contract high of 2,837 points, then pares gains to end up 27.5 points at 2,834.
* German Bund future makes new contract high of 101.66.
* Dollar strength boosts chemicals and auto sectors.
